items.title: Routine Expansion and Market Launch Scale Initiative
items.description: Planned investment to scale routine basket expansion, cross-category recommendations, launch governance, and store readiness into more markets.

customerKPIs.expectedImpact: Increase customer confidence when moving from full-size products to refills.
Improve store readiness for priority collection launches.

businessKPIs.expectedImpact: Increase advisor-led conversion on new launches.

customerKPIs.expectedImpact: Increase launch operator confidence as the governance model scales to more markets.

businessKPIs.expectedImpact: Increase priority launches that arrive on time without material claim, data, or market restriction defects.

Expand launch readiness gates to more markets.
Standardize launch execution tasks for store teams.
